name: A Glasshand
title: Of the Kilns
examine: Forearms scarred smooth by old splashes, eyes narrowed by kiln light. The kilns never cool, so the glasshands work turn and turn about, and sleep like the dead.
lines: Mind the carry poles. Hot glass forgives nothing and neither does Mirena.
You never look straight into the kiln. You learn that once.
Turn and turn about. The fire sleeps when I do, which is never.
